# Custodial

`admin.offering.custodial` · offering_family · parent `—`

> Holding something on the organisation's behalf — records, assets, identity, entitlement — and being able to account for it later. The value is realised entirely in the future, at retrieval, which is why custodial work is under-resourced until the first time it fails.


## Characteristics

|  |  |
|---|---|
| delivery | continuous holding; value realised at retrieval |
| pricing_shape | fixed cost per period, independent of activity |
| margin_profile | stable and unglamorous; underinvestment is invisible for years |
| post_sale_load | permanent — the obligation outlives the transaction that created it |
| notes | Consumers: auditors, regulators, courts, and colleagues years later. Funded by allocated overhead. An internal function with no chargeback has no natural brake on demand, which changes which capabilities matter and is why this line is recorded.  |
